% 23.03.2023 Crl.M.A. 7735/2023 (exemption)
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
By way of this petition filed under Article 227 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 Cr.P.C, petitioners are assailing the judgment dated 04.03.2023.
Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State and counsel for the victims/home buyers appear on advance notice, and accepts notice.
At the outset, it is submitted by the counsel for the victims that they have not been served with the copy of the petition.
Learned senior counsel for the petitioners submits that copy of the petition would be supplied today itself.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned senior counsel for the petitioners that petitioners are not averse to the settlement with the home buyers, and he further submitted that settlement has already taken place with four buyers in the revisional court, and with other four buyers during the course of the pendency of the revision petition.
He further submitted that today also petitioners are ready for any amicable settlement with the respondents.
Counsel appearing for the victims/home buyers submitted that an FIR bearing No. 23/2023 has been registered under Sections 406/420/120B IPC at P.S.EOW.
Learned senior counsel for the petitioners seeks time to amend the prayer clause of the present petition.
Let the needful be done before the next date of hearing.
List on 29th March, 2023.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J MARCH 23, 2023/
